## Environment prohibitions (apply to every agent)
- `kill`/`pkill` inside a container; stopping or removing another agent's stack.
- `docker compose down -v`, resetting the database or deleting volumes of the main stack without authorization.
- Leaving a background process (dev server, `tail -f`) when returning.
- `find /` and searches outside the project folders.
- Running the gate in parallel with e2e.
{{#if BACKEND_PROTECTED_BRANCH}}
- Commit or push to `{{BACKEND_PROTECTED_BRANCH}}`{{#if BACKEND_OWN_REPO}} of `{{BACKEND_DIR}}/`{{/if}}.
{{/if}}
{{#if FRONTEND_PROTECTED_BRANCH}}
{{#unless SAME_DIR}}
- Commit or push to `{{FRONTEND_PROTECTED_BRANCH}}`{{#if FRONTEND_OWN_REPO}} of `{{FRONTEND_DIR}}/`{{/if}}.
{{/unless}}
{{/if}}
{{#if GIT_NO_PUSH}}
- `git push` to any remote: the developer pushes.
